notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 regional Request Attribute Value Update filtering surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies dimension-context and committed-range validation, foreign and uncommitted region rejection, empty and disjoint request behavior, overlapping source selection, default-region object eligibility, and callback-time re-evaluation without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional object registration, region validation, and Request Attribute Value Update services with FederateAmbassador provideAttributeValueUpdate callbacks
